title: Lovely Irish Potato Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful skillet dish featuring Irish potatoes, lovely additions, and a crispy finish.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the chopped lovely and cook for another 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the lovely Irish potato skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
